quests._comment: Quest 1, three-path parity (crate precedent). Beat 1 `resolve` is the SHARED convergence counter `resolved_the_cisterns`, banked by ANY path: FIGHT (shield_spiders on_victory), TALK (Zevara sweep option), or SKILL (banked at Olesm's intel-report, since [Appraise Foe] alone only banks scouted_the_nest). Beat 2 `report` (`cisterns_reported`) is Olesm's completion, banked at report time on all three paths (the SKILL report banks resolve+report together, firing both beats at once -- crate guile precedent). heard_about_cisterns (the grate-gate + quest-start) is NOT a beat; it only opens the door.

quests._comment: Quest 2 'The Wrong Order' (Lyonette, social). Three-path parity mirroring the cisterns two-beat shape. Beat 1 `resolve` is the SHARED convergence counter `resolved_wrong_order`, banked by ANY path: FIGHT-adjacent (supplier_scavengers on_victory), TALK (Krshia smooth-over option), or SKILL (banked at Lyonette's report, since cooking alone only banks stretched_the_order -- cisterns_scout precedent). Beat 2 `report` (`wrong_order_reported`) is Lyonette's gratitude beat, banked at report time on all three paths (the SKILL report banks resolve+report together, firing both beats at once). heard_wrong_order (the quest-start) is NOT a beat; it only opens the give-beat and starts the quest.

quests._comment: (spec §5 RATIFIED earn-shape) Beat 1 'the flicker' (door_chain_started, Erin's post-epilogue line, erin_errand.json) starts the quest but is NOT itself a beat (heard_about_cisterns/heard_wrong_order precedent -- it only opens the mage-consult gate). Beat 'consult' is the SHARED convergence counter door_understood, banked by ANY of Pisces's 3-path mage consult (FIGHT: clear rift_vermin_leak in the inn; TALK: persuade Pisces to examine it himself; SKILL: read the doorframe's wardwork with [Observe] and report back -- pisces_magic.json). Beat 'recover' requires BOTH recovered_anchor_stone (the ruin run's anchor_stone_pedestal, gated open via the internal pedestal_unsealed convergence counter -- cleared_ruin_guardian OR either of the TALK/SKILL door_understood legs) AND bought_catalyst (Krshia's resonant_catalyst, 35g, her charms buy node) -- spec §5.3's 'ruin + Krshia ONLY' attunement components, both order-independent (either can be earned first). D4 consumes this chain's completion to start the study-sleeps counter toward the awakening beat; door_that_goes_elsewhere has no further beats here by design (awakening/the portal menu are D4's own sim surface, not a quest beat).
quests.title: The Door That Goes Elsewhere

beats.description: Find out what's happening with the pantry door -- fight it, talk to Pisces, or read the wardwork yourself.
Recover the anchor stone from the ruin east past the gate road, on the floodplains, and buy Krshia's catalyst to attune it.

quests._resolution_paths_comment: Issue #79: FIGHT (cleared_the_leak, rift_vermin_leak's own on_victory) and SKILL (read_the_door_runes, pantry_door_runes' [Observe]) each bank a distinct intermediate producer -- but the TALK leg (pisces_magic.json's consult_talk_done) banks door_understood directly with no distinct producer of its own (only the shared persuaded_someone flag, which isn't path-exclusive -- a player could have persuaded someone ELSE first in a different quest), so it falls to the fallback entry (empty accomplishment, always matches once neither of the first two fired).

resolution_paths.text: You fought the rift vermin in the cellar.
You read the wardwork yourself.
You consulted Pisces about it.

quests._comment: 8b R3 (issue #11) 'The Price of a Favor' (Riverfarm). Three-path parity mirroring the cisterns/wrong_order two-beat shape. Beat 1 `resolve` is the SHARED convergence counter `blight_lifted`, banked by ANY path: FIGHT (briar_collectors_deep on_victory -- clearing the escalated wave is the collecting craft's real source), TALK (the witch's own hub, a [Diplomat]-gated mediation banking a renegotiated year of hearth-tending), or SKILL (the hollow_true_knot prop -- the gauntlet's own [Observe] finish IS the resolution, no separate report needed, unlike cisterns_scout/wrong_order's single-action precedent). Beat 2 `report` (`price_of_a_favor_reported`) is the headman's closing beat, identical on all three paths. heard_price_of_a_favor (the quest-start, riverfarm_headman.json) is NOT a beat; it only opens the report option and starts the quest. blight_lifted ALSO drives the village visual_states brighten, the witch's vendor unlock, and the charmed villager's echo retirement -- none of those are quest beats, all three read the SAME raw accomplishment counter this beat completes on.
quests.title: The Price of a Favor

beats.description: Settle the debt collecting on Riverfarm -- the witch in the hollow west of the fields is the one collecting it. Drive her off, broker fair terms, or pay it yourself.
Tell the headman it's done.

resolution_paths.text: You drove off the collectors by force.
You brokered fair terms with the witch.
You paid the debt yourself, at the standing stones.

quests._comment: Invrisil 8c Task C3 (issue #13) 'A Gentleman's Disagreement'. Three-path parity mirroring the cisterns/wrong_order/price_of_a_favor two-beat shape. Beat 1 `resolve` is the SHARED convergence counter `merchant_fate_decided`, banked by EITHER of the mutually-exclusive fork endings in data/dialogue/invrisil_merchant_prince.json's `cornered` node (`merchant_exposed` XOR `merchant_extorted` -- the plan's locked shape 5 fork contract) once Coyle is cornered via ANY of the 3 paths: STEALTH (`lifted_true_ledger`, the counting_house_ledger prop's [Appraise Foe] beat), TALK (`secured_testimony`, already shipped by C1's invrisil_fixer.json testimony chain), or FIGHT (`forced_confession`, the `hired_blades` encounter's on_victory). Beat 2 `report` (`brothers_job_done`) is Wilovan's closing beat at the parlor (data/dialogue/invrisil_wilovan.json hub->marker), identical on all 3 paths/both forks -- it ALSO banks the shared `brothers_marker` (vendor/perk gate, shape 5) and fires the safe-passage reward (`remove_entity` on both alley footpads) there, since that is the genuine 'quest complete' moment regardless of which fork or path got you there. `took_brothers_job` (the give-beat, Wilovan's commission node) is NOT a beat; it only opens the accusation door and starts the quest. GH#68 (issue #68, quest-stage depth standard) REWORK: prepended a NEW beat 0 `scout` (SHARED, `coyle_operation_found` -- the new invrisil_boulevard `coyle_operation_lookout` prop) so the quest genuinely walks 3 real stages per path (scout -> the now-gated per-path evidence beat -> resolve/report, unchanged) instead of resolving off a single ungated evidence beat. Per-path Stage 2 gates (SKILL: counting_house_watch's `assessed_guard_pattern` in front of the ledger's real effect; TALK: 2 rumor purchases + the cups_favor carry banking `returned_cups_debt` in front of `balk`'s real options; FIGHT: the coyle_runner_trail/warehouse_approach tailing pair banking `warehouse_located` in front of Wilovan's `fists_door` come-along) are DELIBERATELY NOT separate quest beats -- props can only bank ONE accomplishment per on_skill_use/on_interact_accomplishment call (no multi-bank, no OR-shape shared counter reachable from a prop without new sim code), so a second 'evidence' beat would need either new prop machinery or repurposing an existing per-path id (both ruled out by the additive-gates-only constraint). `resolve`'s existing `merchant_fate_decided` already only fires AFTER a path's now-gated evidence beat, so the gate is real and mechanically enforced even though the journal doesn't carry it as its own beat row -- disclosed simplification, flagged for controller review. `beat_index` walks in order (WIQuests.beat_index, first-unmet-wins) -- every shipped canonical (invrisil_walkthrough live, the 3 disagreement fixtures pre-banked) now walks `scout` before `resolve` so the emitted `quest_beat_completed` payloads shift by ONE FROM their pre-rework numbering (old beat:1/beat:2 -> beat:2/beat:3); all 3 disagreement scripts' waits were re-pinned accordingly.
quests.title: A Gentleman's Disagreement

The 3 info-gathering methods (STEALTH/TALK/FIGHT) feed the SAME resolve beat regardless of which fork is chosen, so they aren't separately surfaced here.

You extorted Coyle for gold.

quests._comment: 8d C1 (issue #14) 'What the Seal Kept' -- the Liscor dungeon (dungeon_approach/trapped_halls, gated behind the reopened M-ARC gallery). FOUR real stages, not the cisterns/wrong_order two-beat shape: this is a genuine dungeon, not a posting. Beat 'delve' (`horns_party_formed`) is Ceria's own recruit-conversation at dungeon_approach, the ally_requires gate for the vault fight -- the option that starts this quest at Olesm's desk (`horns_delve_started`, olesm_intro.json) is NOT itself a beat (heard_about_cisterns precedent), it only opens the gallery door (B3's door_when) and banks the stipend's ADVANCE half. Beat 'halls' (`halls_cleared`) is the SHARED three-pillar convergence counter in trapped_halls: FIGHT (the promoted snare_nest_slot encounter's on_victory), SKILL (dart_slit_a's on_skill_use, trap_kit consumed), TALK (Ksmvr's plates-guidance option, `ksmvr_plates.json` -- ALSO banks `guided_ksmvr_through_plates`, the real cost `ally_hp_penalty` reads at the vault fight). Beat 'vault' (`seal_kept_found`) folds the boss victory (`vault_construct_downed`, `ally_requires: horns_party_formed`) and the FIND beat (the deeper rune-door prop, `contains_when`-shaped gate on the SAME victory counter) into one journal row -- finding the door is impossible without the victory, so a separate row would never show independently. Beat 'report' (`seal_kept_reported`) is Olesm's own closing beat, same map as the giver (no travel-signposting requirement per issue #74's own same-map exemption). heard_of_the_gallery_survey (the guild_board rumor) is NOT a beat, flavor-only signpost.
quests.title: What the Seal Kept

beats.description: Reach the reopened gallery in the dungeon beneath Liscor and find Ceria Springwalker's team waiting.

quests._resolution_paths_comment: Issue #79: only the TALK leg (guided_ksmvr_through_plates, ksmvr_plates.json) banks a distinct producer of its own -- both FIGHT (the promoted snare's on_victory) and SKILL (dart_slit_a's disarm) bank halls_cleared directly with no separate id (the old flavor-only disarmed_dart_line id was retired, see skeleton_scene.json's own trap-class comment), so they share the fallback entry -- a real, disclosed narrowing (can't distinguish FIGHT from SKILL after the fact from existing data alone).

resolution_paths.text: You guided Ksmvr through the pressure plates.
You cleared the trapped halls yourself.

quests._comment: Issue #81 (exploration & optional content gap-analysis), first of two OPTIONAL mini-quests built to the 2-beat quest-stage floor (GH#68's own ruling: 'the quest-stage standard's floor for optional content can be 2'). POSTING-SEEDED: the hook is a guild_board `board_rumors` entry (`rumor_missing_recruit`, data/skeleton_scene.json) -- the SAME signpost idiom rumor_riverfarm/rumor_invrisil/rumor_dungeon_survey already use, banking a flavor-only `heard_about_missing_recruit` that is NOT itself a beat (heard_about_cisterns precedent) and only opens Dresk's own new `dresk_recruit` conversation option at the barracks. Beat 'search' (`found_missing_recruit`) is a REAL travel beat -- produced only on the sewers map (recruit_pell's own dialogue effect), a different map than the giver (barracks), so its description names the sewers landmark per `_validate_travel_beat_place_naming`. Beat 'report' (`recruit_reported_safe`) is Dresk's own closing beat, same map as the giver (no landmark needed). Single-path by design (no FIGHT/TALK/SKILL fork) -- an optional side-quest, not a main-quest beat; its real cost is the travel + the sewers' own existing danger (heard_about_cisterns gate, sewer_vermin encounter en route), not a Skill/gold toll.
quests.title: The Missing Recruit

beats.description: Find Recruit Pell -- last seen chasing a noise down in the sewers beneath the market -- before the Watch has to call it something worse.
Walk Pell back to the barracks and tell Sergeant Ashgrave they're safe.

quests._comment: Issue #81, second OPTIONAL mini-quest, the 2-beat floor's same-map shape (contrast the_missing_recruit's cross-map one): both beats resolve on the SAME map as the giver (guild), the 'a gate opening / information re-gating a hub' state-change SKILL.md's stage definition sanctions instead of travel -- Renn's own explanation (the 'ask' option) is what makes the gear-stash prop's location legible, and holding the recovered item is what opens his turn-in option (a real gate, not a formality). POSTING-SEEDED: guild_board's `rumor_lost_hammer` board_rumors entry banks the flavor-only `heard_about_lost_hammer` hook (NOT a beat), pointing at Renn by name -- the SAME board that seeds the_missing_recruit, per THE REQUEST BOARD's own established convention of carrying several live rumors at once. Beat 'search' (`found_the_warhammer`) is banked by renns_gear_stash's `on_open_accomplishment` (a container prop, guild). Beat 'report' (`returned_the_warhammer`) is Renn's own turn-in option, gated on carrying the item (`requires: {item: renns_warhammer}`, the sixth sanctioned single-key gate).
quests.title: Renn's Old Warhammer

beats.description: Track down Renn's backup warhammer somewhere in the Guild hall -- he swears he left it by the back wall.
Return the warhammer to Renn, at the Guild.
